'''Docking berth 14''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] located in [[Quantill City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] team docked their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Gambit]]'', in docking berth 14 while investigating an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ando Project|operation]] on the world.<ref name="Ando">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref>
